<size=40><color=Title>Unseen Snare</color></size>
Chisa inflicts <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare</color> on the target for {0}s in the following 4 ways:
- Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>.
- Hitting a target within a certain period of time after casting <color=Highlight>Serrated Loop</color>.
- Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Locking</color> on to a target.
When targets marked by <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare</color> take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on them. This effect can be triggered up to once every {2}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Thread of Bane</color></size>
When dealing damage to targets affected by <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color>, ignore {4} of their DEF.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Mode</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa unlocks <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color>, <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>.
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> consume <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> on hit.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sawring - Blitz</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> chains up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.  
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to start the combo from <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 1</color>. Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to start from <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color> to continuously attack the target. <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color> is automatically followed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>, release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button or <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> without directional input to automatically cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color>, successful Dodges can be triggered.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to continuously attack the target. <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> is automatically followed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>.
Release <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> during <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> to automatically cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> following a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> following <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to sustain the attack. When <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> ends, cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> automatically.
Release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button or <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> without directional input while casting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color> automatically.
<color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> deals <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sawring - Eradication</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa casts <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> in the following 2 ways:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after consuming all <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> with <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> or <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>.
Attacking targets with <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> deals <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and grants Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team for {5}s.
The skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Every {6} point of <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> consumed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> increases the DMG Multiplier of the next <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>. Up to {7} points will be counted toward this effect.
Casting this skill consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> and ends <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Fever</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color>.
<color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> is at 100% by default.
When Chisa goes on for a period without dealing any damage, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa enters the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color> and exits <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa resets <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> when dealing damage or when casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> and <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.
While in the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa exits the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>.
When in <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, Chisa exits the state upon dealing damage, or casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lifethread - Glide</color></size>
When Chisa is not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> and has more than {3} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color>, she can consume {8} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color> in the following 5 ways:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> in mid-air before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>.
- While in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> or <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> forward shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Thread Withdrawn</color>.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing when launched into mid-air.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.
Casting this skill can pull in nearby enemies marked by <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color>.
During the skill, hold <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to glide a short distance on the weapon.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after casting this skill.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Ring of Chainsaw</color></size>
Chisa can hold up to {9} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Normal Attack </color> and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> grants <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> grants {10} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> grants {11} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lifethread - Jetstream</color></size>
Chisa can hold up to {12} points of <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color>. 
Chisa continuously obtains <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> over time.
Chisa obtains {13} points of <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> upon defeating a target. 
Exiting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> resets <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> to the max limit.
Chisa cannot obtain <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> passively for a short period of time after casting  <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Unseen Snare</color></size>
Chisa áp đặt <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare</color> lên mục tiêu trong {0}s theo 4 cách sau:
- Trúng mục tiêu bằng <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>.
- Trúng mục tiêu trong khoảng thời gian nhất định sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Serrated Loop</color>.
- Trúng mục tiêu bằng <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Locking</color> mục tiêu.
Khi mục tiêu bị đánh dấu <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare</color> chịu sát thương trực tiếp từ Resonators, Chisa sẽ áp đặt <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> lên chúng. Hiệu ứng này có thể kích hoạt tối đa mỗi {2}s một lần.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Thread of Bane</color></size>
Khi gây sát thương lên mục tiêu bị ảnh hưởng bởi <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color>, bỏ qua {4} DEF của chúng.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Mode</color></size>
Khi ở <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa mở khóa <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color>, <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>.
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> và <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> tiêu hao <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> khi trúng mục tiêu.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sawring - Blitz</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> có thể thực hiện liên tiếp 3 đòn tấn công, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> để bắt đầu chuỗi từ <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 1</color>. Giữ <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> để bắt đầu từ <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>.
Giữ <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> khi đang thực hiện <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color> để tấn công liên tục. <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color> sẽ tự động chuyển sang <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
Trong khi thực hiện <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>, thả nút <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> không có hướng di chuyển để tự động thực hiện <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color>, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Ngay sau khi thực hiện <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color>, có thể kích hoạt Dodge thành công.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> ngay sau khi thực hiện <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color> để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
Trong khi thực hiện <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>, giữ <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> để tấn công liên tục. <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> sẽ tự động chuyển sang <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>.
Thả <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> trong <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> để tự động thực hiện <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Sát thương của <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> được tính là <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color></size>
Khi ở <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> sau khi <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> thành công để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> sau khi thực hiện <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
Giữ <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> khi đang thực hiện <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> để duy trì tấn công. Khi <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> kết thúc, sẽ tự động thực hiện <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
Thả nút <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> không có hướng di chuyển khi đang thực hiện <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> để tự động thực hiện <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color>.
<color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> gây <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sawring - Eradication</color></size>
Khi ở <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa thực hiện <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> theo 2 cách sau:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> sau khi thực hiện <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> sau khi tiêu hao hết <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> bằng <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>.
Tấn công mục tiêu bằng <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> và tạo Khiên cho tất cả Resonators gần đó trong đội trong {5}s.
Sát thương của kỹ năng được tính là <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Mỗi {6} điểm <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> tiêu hao bởi <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> và <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> sẽ tăng Hệ Số Sát Thương của <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> tiếp theo. Tối đa {7} điểm sẽ được tính cho hiệu ứng này.
Sử dụng kỹ năng này sẽ tiêu hao toàn bộ <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> và kết thúc <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Fever</color></size>
Khi ở <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> được thay thế bằng <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color>.
<color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> mặc định ở mức 100%.
Khi Chisa không gây sát thương trong một khoảng thời gian, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> sẽ giảm nhanh. Khi xuống còn 0, Chisa sẽ rơi vào <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color> và thoát khỏi <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
Khi ở <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa sẽ đặt lại <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> khi gây sát thương hoặc khi sử dụng Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> và <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.
Khi ở <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> sẽ giảm nhanh. Khi xuống còn 0, Chisa sẽ thoát khỏi <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>.
Khi ở <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, Chisa sẽ thoát khỏi trạng thái này khi gây sát thương hoặc sử dụng Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> và Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lifethread - Glide</color></size>
Khi Chisa không ở <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> và có hơn {3} điểm <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color>, cô ấy có thể tiêu hao {8} điểm <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color> theo 5 cách sau:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> trên không trước khi hạ cánh sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>.
- Khi đang trên không, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> trước khi hạ cánh sau khi sử dụng Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> về phía trước ngay sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Thread Withdrawn</color>.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> trước khi hạ cánh khi bị tung lên không.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> trước khi hạ cánh sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.
Sử dụng kỹ năng này có thể kéo những kẻ địch gần đó bị đánh dấu bởi <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color> về phía mình.
Trong khi sử dụng kỹ năng, giữ <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> để lướt một đoạn ngắn trên vũ khí.
Có thể kích hoạt Dodge thành công trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định sau khi sử dụng kỹ năng này.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Ring of Chainsaw</color></size>
Chisa có thể giữ tối đa {9} điểm <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Trúng mục tiêu bằng <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> và Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> sẽ nhận được <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Sử dụng Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> sẽ nhận được {10} điểm <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Sử dụng Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> sẽ nhận được {11} điểm <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lifethread - Jetstream</color></size>
Chisa có thể giữ tối đa {12} điểm <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color>.
Chisa liên tục nhận được <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> theo thời gian.
Chisa nhận được {13} điểm <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> khi đánh bại mục tiêu.
Thoát khỏi <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> sẽ đặt lại <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> về giới hạn tối đa.
Chisa không thể nhận <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> một cách thụ động trong một khoảng thời gian ngắn sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Optical Sampling Stage</color></size>
Lynae is in <color=Highlight><te href=150901>Optical Sampling Stage</te></color> by default. While in this state, <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> recovers during certain skills.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color> sends Lynae into <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>. In this state, Lynae continuously recovers <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> while moving on the ground or during certain periods of certain skills. Lynae will not Walk during this state, and her Running and Sprinting will be replaced by the faster <color=Highlight>Free Skating</color> and <color=Highlight>Speed Skating</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, with at least 1/3 of the max <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, Jump is replaced by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color>.
Consume 1/3 of the max <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit. Successful Dodges can be triggered within a certain time during this skill. While airborne, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> chains up to 3 stages. Switching to another Resonator resets the combo.
While in combat, each stage of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> cast recovers 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.
Within a certain time after <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 1</color> {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 2</color> also pulls in nearby targets.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color></size>
During <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> is on cooldown, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color></size>
During <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, and this skill is not on cooldown, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color> and grants all nearby Resonators in the team {0} points of Tune Break Boost for {1}s.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>. 
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode</color></size>
Inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> when hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors!</color>.
Lynae can switch between <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> on targets for 25s.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on targets for 25s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis</color></size>
Deal an instance of <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Tune Rupture DMG, to targets within range affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Overflow</color></size>
Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Overflow.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150901>Optical Sampling Stage</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> recovers during Basic Attack, Lynae-Style Palettes, Mid-air Attack, and Dodge Counter, or when Intro Skill is cast.
When <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> is full, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color> becomes available.
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lumiflow</color></size>
Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Lumiflow.
During <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>:
- Restore 20% of <color=Highlight>Lumiflow</color> per second when Lynae is moving on the ground/climbing, or performs a successful Dodge on the ground, or within a certain time during <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter</color>, <color=Highlight>Additive Color</color>, ground Dodge, Intro Skill, or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Lumiflow</color> starts to deplete by 20% per second while Lynae is staying still on the ground/climbing/swimming or off the field, or after a certain time following the use of the skills listed above.
- <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> does not change while Lynae is not in any of the states described above.
Exiting <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>.
With 120 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, Lynae's roller skating speed further increases. <color=Highlight>Speed Skating</color> consumes STA over time.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>True Color</color></size>
Lynae can hold up to 3 points of True Color.
During combat, each time <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> is cast, gain 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>. With 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color> and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> become available.
Exiting <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.

Trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 1</color> {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Kỹ Năng Thường trên mặt đất để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

Skill này tiêu hao 3 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Kỹ Năng Thường trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định khi sử dụng kỹ năng này để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color></size>
Trong trạng thái <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, khi Lynae ở trên không với 3 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color> và kỹ năng này không Cooldown, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Kỹ Năng Thường hoặc Resonance Skill để gây <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> và gây hiệu ứng <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> lên mục tiêu trúng đòn.
Skill này tiêu hao 3 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color> và cấp cho tất cả Resonators trong đội gần đó {0} điểm Tăng Cường Phá Vỡ Giai Tune trong {1} giây.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Kỹ Năng Thường trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định khi sử dụng kỹ năng này để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode</color></size>
Gây hiệu ứng <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> khi trúng mục tiêu bằng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> và <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors!</color>.
Lynae có thể chuyển đổi giữa <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color> và <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>:
- Khi ở <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> sẽ gây hiệu ứng <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> lên mục tiêu trong 25 giây.
- Khi ở <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> sẽ gây hiệu ứng <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> lên mục tiêu trong 25 giây.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis</color></size>

<size=40><color=Title>Overflow</color></size>

Khi <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> đầy, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color> sẽ khả dụng.
Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color> sẽ loại bỏ toàn bộ <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lumiflow</color></size>
Lynae có thể giữ tối đa 120 điểm Lumiflow.
Trong trạng thái <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>:
- Restore 20% <color=Highlight>Lumiflow</color> mỗi giây khi Lynae di chuyển trên mặt đất/leo trèo, hoặc thực hiện Dodge Thành Công trên mặt đất, hoặc trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter</color>, <color=Highlight>Additive Color</color>, Dodge trên mặt đất, Intro Skill, hoặc <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Lumiflow</color> bắt đầu giảm 20% mỗi giây khi Lynae đứng yên trên mặt đất/leo trèo/bơi lội hoặc rời khỏi chiến trường, hoặc sau một khoảng thời gian nhất định sau khi sử dụng các kỹ năng được liệt kê ở trên.
- <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> không thay đổi khi Lynae không ở trong bất kỳ trạng thái nào được mô tả ở trên.
Thoát khỏi <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color> sẽ loại bỏ toàn bộ <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>.
Với 120 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, tốc độ trượt patin của Lynae sẽ tăng thêm. <color=Highlight>Speed Skating</color> tiêu hao STA theo thời gian.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>True Color</color></size>
Lynae có thể giữ tối đa 3 điểm True Color.
Trong chiến đấu, mỗi lần sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> sẽ nhận được 1 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>. Với 3 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color> và <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> sẽ khả dụng.
Thoát khỏi <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color> sẽ loại bỏ toàn bộ <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Threshold State</color></size>
By default, Galbrena is in <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, and in this state, she accumulates <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Demon Hypostasis</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>, Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Volley of Death, Mid-air Attack - Ashfall Barrage, Dodge Counter - Blood for Blood, and Resonance Skill - Encroach are replaced with Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution, Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict, Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage, Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge, and Resonance Skill - Ravage, which consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>, every point of <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> increases the DMG of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge</color> by {0}, up to {1}, which is removed upon exiting <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.
When <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> depletes or after staying in <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color> for over 50s, <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color> ends automatically.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution</color></size>
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. Stage 1 to 3 DMG are considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>, and Stage 4 & 5 DMG <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 5</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict</color></size>
Consume STA to attack the target and perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. Stage 3 DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 1</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 2</color>. 
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 2 & 3</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>. 
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage</color></size>
While in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack to consume STA to perform aerial attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit.
While in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to continuously consume STA to launch a barrage of shots at targets, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. If Galbrena does not land when interrupted during the barrage, she cannot immediately cast this skill again. Release Normal Attack during the barrage to cast Plunging Attack. 
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after the Plunging Attack to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>. 
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 4</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color></size>
Dash forward and leap into the air. Flip backward upon hitting the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color> share a cooldown.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Hellstride</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge on the ground while casting <color=Highlight>Galbrena's own skills</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> to deal a fixed amount of <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG that does not bear any effect from DMG buffs. <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> can trigger successful Dodges. <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> cannot be cast consecutively.
Casting this skill does not reset the attack cycles within a short period of time.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Burning Drive</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color>, <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Seraphic Execution Basic Attack Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color> increases Galbrena's resistance to interruptions and ATK by {2} for {3}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Afterflame</color></size>
Galbrena can hold up to 40 points of <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, Galbrena recovers 8 points of <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> when Resonators in the nearby team cast Echo Skill. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. This effect resets when Galbrena exits <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.
All <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> is removed upon exiting <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sinflame</color></size>
Galbrena can hold up to 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, hitting an enemy with Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Volley of Death, Mid-air Attack - Ashfall Barrage, Resonance Skill - Encroach, and Intro Skill - Hellflare Overload recovers <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Demon Hypostasis</color></size>

Khi ở <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>, mỗi điểm <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> sẽ tăng Sát Thương của <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color>, và <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge</color> lên {0}, tối đa {1}, và sẽ bị loại bỏ khi rời khỏi <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.
Khi <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> cạn kiệt hoặc sau khi duy trì <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color> quá 50 giây, <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color> sẽ tự động kết thúc.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution</color></size>
Thực hiện tối đa 5 đòn tấn công liên tiếp, gây <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Tiêu hao <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> khi trúng đích. Sát thương từ Giai đoạn 1 đến 3 được tính là <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>, và Sát thương từ Giai đoạn 4 & 5 là <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 5</color> để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict</color></size>
Tiêu hao STA để tấn công mục tiêu và thực hiện tối đa 3 đòn tấn công liên tiếp, gây <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Tiêu hao <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> khi trúng đích. Sát thương từ Giai đoạn 3 được tính là <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 1</color> để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 2</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 2 & 3</color> để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage</color></size>
Khi ở giữa không, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack để tiêu hao STA và thực hiện đòn tấn công trên không, gây <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, được tính là <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Tiêu hao <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> khi trúng đích.
Khi ở giữa không, giữ Normal Attack để liên tục tiêu hao STA và bắn một loạt đạn vào mục tiêu, gây <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, được tính là <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Tiêu hao <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> khi trúng đích. Nếu Galbrena không tiếp đất khi bị gián đoạn trong loạt đạn, cô không thể sử dụng kỹ năng này ngay lập tức. Thả Normal Attack trong loạt đạn để thực hiện Đòn Đòn Lao Xuống.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack sau Đòn Đòn Lao Xuống để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack ngay sau khi Dodge thành công để tấn công mục tiêu, gây <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, được tính là <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack ngay sau khi sử dụng kỹ năng này để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 4</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color></size>
Lao về phía trước và nhảy lên không. Lật người lại khi trúng mục tiêu, gây <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, được tính là <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Tiêu hao <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> khi trúng đích. <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color> và <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color> chia sẻ Cooldown chiêu.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Hellstride</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Dodge trên mặt đất trong khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Galbrena's own skills</color> để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color>, gây một lượng <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> cố định, được tính là Sát Thương Basic Attack và không chịu ảnh hưởng từ các hiệu ứng tăng Sát Thương. <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> có thể kích hoạt Dodge thành công. <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> không thể sử dụng liên tiếp.
Sử dụng kỹ năng này không làm reset chu kỳ tấn công trong một khoảng thời gian ngắn.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Burning Drive</color></size>
Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color>, <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Seraphic Execution Basic Attack Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice</color>, và <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color> sẽ tăng Kháng Gián Đoạn và Attack của Galbrena lên {2} trong {3} giây.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Afterflame</color></size>
Galbrena có thể tích lũy tối đa 40 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color>.
Khi ở <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, Galbrena hồi phục 8 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> khi Resonators trong đội gần đó sử dụng Kỹ Năng Echoes. Các Echoes cùng tên chỉ có thể kích hoạt hiệu ứng này một lần. Hiệu ứng này sẽ được reset khi Galbrena rời khỏi <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.
Toàn bộ <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> sẽ bị loại bỏ khi rời khỏi <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sinflame</color></size>
Galbrena có thể tích lũy tối đa 100 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.
Khi ở <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, trúng đích kẻ địch bằng Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Loạn Tiễn Tử Thần, Đòn Mid-air Attack - Mưa Tro Tàn, Resonance Skill - Xâm Lấn, và Intro Skill - Quá Tải Hỏa Diệm sẽ hồi phục <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Seraphic Duo</color></size>
When casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 4</color>, enter <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> for {1}s. 
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Overture</color></size>
When Aemeath is in <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> and the <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> is no less than {0} points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Overture</color> at the cost of {29} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Switch into the Mech form after casting this skill and exit <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period of time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Encore</color></size>
In the Mech form, when in <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> and the <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> is no less than {0} points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Encore</color> at the cost of {29} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Switch back to Aemeath and exit the <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> state. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode</color></size>
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, when Resonators in the team respond to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, inflict <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> on the target for {4}s, stacking up to {3} times.
<size=10></size>
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, inflict <SapTag=5>{5}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=5} of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> for {7}s, stacking up to {6} times.
While in combat, when the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on targets near the active Resonator reaches {8} stacks, inflict {9} stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>. If the targets have more than {10} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, trigger <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> based on their max stack limit and remove all of their stacks.
<size=10></size>
In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> when the following skills deal damage. The same skill can only trigger this effect on the same target once every {27}s:
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3 & 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3 & 4</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color>, and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color>.
<size=10></size>
Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> removes <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> stacks on nearby targets and additionally deals {11} instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>, each time to a random target within range. For each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> removed from a target, the DMG Multiplier of the additional instances of Tune Rupture DMG triggered by <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> against the target is increased by {12}. This effect lasts for {28}s. The target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> does not affect the triggering of these instances of Tune Rupture DMG.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> removes the <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> stacks on targets if they are inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, and trigger the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the target based on its max stack limit without removing its stacks. Each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> removed from the target increases the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the main target by {13}.
<size=10></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Stardust Resonance</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> additionally deal {14} instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>.
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> on the main target is additionally increased by {15}. The DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that provided by <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Starburst</color></size>
Active in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>. Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> to targets within range that are affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, considered Tune Rupture DMG.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Starflux Thrust</color></size>
When in the Mech form and <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color> is more than {16}, use the Utility button to cast <color=Highlight>Starflux Thrust</color> and soar in the air by continuously consuming <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Synchronization Rate</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color> is capped at {17} points.
- Dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Mech</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Mech</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color> recovers <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
- Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color> and <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color> recovers {18} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> recovers {19} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
- When in <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> at the same time, casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II</color> recovers {21} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Rate</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color> is capped at {22} points.
- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> recovers {23} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.
- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> recovers {24} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.
- When in <color=Highlight>Starlume Acceleration</color>, casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> additionally recovers {25} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Starflux</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Starflux</color> is capped at {26} points.
<color=Highlight>Starflux</color> recovers naturally over time.

<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Present Self</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Glacio Bite</color></size>
- While Hiyuki is in the team, <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is converted to <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>. Every time a new stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> is inflicted on a target, an instance of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is triggered based on that enemy's current <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> stack limit. <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> can be inflicted on <color=Highlight>frozen</color> targets. <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> is also considered <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is also considered <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te> DMG</color>.
- When <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> hits a target, if the target has no fewer than {0} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>, consume <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} and trigger <color=Highlight><te href=110808>Frostbind</te></color> once. 
- When Hiyuki joins the team, remove all stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> from the targets. When Hiyuki leaves the team, if there is no other Resonator in the team who can convert <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> into <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>, all enemies' <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> stacks are cleared.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Present Self</color></size>
Hiyuki starts in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>. While in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>, casting certain skills restores <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaimed Self</color></size>
Hiyuki enters <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color> after casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color>. While in <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>, Hiyuki unlocks new moves and restores <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> through certain attacks.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Iai Stance</color></size>
If Hiyuki has at least 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>, performing any of the following actions causes her to flash backward at the cost of STA and enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> after casting any <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self</color> other than <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Frostedge</color>.
- Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> within a certain period after casting <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> or <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.
While performing the actions above, if there is a valid target within the range and the forward input is held down, Hiyuki instead flashes behind the enemy at the cost of STA and enters <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>.
Hiyuki may enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> while airborne. Upon entering the <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, Hiyuki's mid-air Dodge charges are reset. <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> ends if Hiyuki is switched out.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Iai</color></size>
Within a certain period after entering <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> and consume 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
If <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> remains at 100 points or above after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> again.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, neutralize this instance of damage and become immune to interruptions for a certain duration afterwards while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%.
Each time <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> is cast, if Hiyuki has <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>, consume 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> to inflict 3 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on hit, and gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dedication</color></size>
Hiyuki holds up to  300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Present Self</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> may be restored via the following ways:
- Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color> restores 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Frostedge</color> restores 200 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color> enhances the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>, which now additionally restores 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>. This effect ends when Hiyuki is switched out.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Frostheart</color></size>
Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> is restored while casting <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> and <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>, or when <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self</color> other than <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> hits the target.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Frostharden Iai</color></size>
<color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> has a maximum of 3 points.
Casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> grants 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Whiteout Bitterfrost</color></size>
<color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color> stacks up to 3 times.
Each time <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> is consumed through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Snowforged Blade</color></size>
<color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> stacks up to 3 times.
Each time <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> is cast, gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Glacio Bite</color></size>
- Khi Hiyuki có mặt trong đội, <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> gây ra bởi Resonators gần đó trong đội sẽ được chuyển hóa thành <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>. Mỗi khi một lớp <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> mới được áp lên mục tiêu, một lượng <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> sẽ được kích hoạt dựa trên giới hạn lớp <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> hiện tại của kẻ địch đó. <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> có thể được áp lên mục tiêu đang <color=Highlight>frozen</color>. <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> cũng được coi là <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> và <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> cũng được coi là <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color>.
- Khi <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> trúng mục tiêu, nếu mục tiêu có ít nhất {0} lớp <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>, tiêu hao <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=lớp P=lớp SapTag=1} và kích hoạt <color=Highlight><te href=110808>Frostbind</te></color> một lần.
- Khi Hiyuki gia nhập đội, tất cả lớp <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> trên mục tiêu sẽ bị xóa. Khi Hiyuki rời đội, nếu không còn Resonators nào khác trong đội có thể chuyển hóa <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> thành <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>, tất cả lớp <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> của kẻ địch sẽ bị xóa.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Present Self</color></size>
Hiyuki bắt đầu ở trạng thái <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>. Khi ở trạng thái <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>, sử dụng một số kỹ năng sẽ hồi phục <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaimed Self</color></size>
Hiyuki chuyển sang trạng thái <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color> sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color>. Khi ở trạng thái <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>, Hiyuki mở khóa các động tác mới và hồi phục <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> thông qua một số đòn tấn công.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Iai Stance</color></size>
Nếu Hiyuki có ít nhất 100 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>, thực hiện bất kỳ hành động nào sau đây sẽ khiến cô lướt lùi với chi phí STA và vào <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> sau khi sử dụng bất kỳ <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self</color> nào khác ngoài <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, hoặc <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Frostedge</color>.
- Giữ <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.
Trong khi thực hiện các hành động trên, nếu có mục tiêu hợp lệ trong phạm vi và giữ nút di chuyển về phía trước, Hiyuki sẽ lướt ra sau lưng kẻ địch với chi phí STA và vào <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>.
Hiyuki có thể vào <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> khi đang ở trên không. Khi vào <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, số lần Dodge trên không của Hiyuki sẽ được làm mới. <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> sẽ kết thúc nếu Hiyuki bị thay ra.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Iai</color></size>
Trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định sau khi vào <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> và tiêu hao 100 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> để sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, gây <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, được tính là Sát Thương Resonance Liberation.
Nếu <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> vẫn còn từ 100 điểm trở lên sau khi sử dụng kỹ năng này, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định để sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> lại.
Nếu Hiyuki bị tấn công bởi kẻ địch trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định khi đang sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, lượng sát thương này sẽ bị vô hiệu hóa và cô trở nên miễn nhiễm với gián đoạn trong một khoảng thời gian sau đó, đồng thời giảm 100% tất cả sát thương nhận vào.
Mỗi lần sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, nếu Hiyuki có <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>, tiêu hao 1 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> để gây 3 lớp <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> khi trúng mục tiêu, và nhận 1 lớp <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dedication</color></size>
Hiyuki có thể giữ tối đa 300 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
Khi ở trạng thái <color=Highlight>Present Self</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> có thể được hồi phục bằng các cách sau:
- Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color> hồi phục 100 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
- Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Frostedge</color> hồi phục 200 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color> sẽ tăng cường <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color> tiếp theo, giúp hồi phục thêm 100 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>. Hiệu ứng này sẽ kết thúc khi Hiyuki bị thay ra.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Frostheart</color></size>
Hiyuki có thể giữ tối đa 300 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> được hồi phục khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> và <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>, hoặc khi <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self</color> (ngoại trừ <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>) trúng mục tiêu.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Frostharden Iai</color></size>
<color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> có tối đa 3 điểm.
Sử dụng <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> sẽ nhận được 3 điểm <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>.
<size=10></size>

<size=40><color=Title>Heliacal Ember</color></size>
When Zani is in the team and a nearby Resonator inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> upon a target, immediately consume all Spectro Frazzle stacks and trigger the corresponding DMG, then convert Spectro Frazzle into an equal number of Heliacal Embers. Every time the conversion happens, Zani obtains Blaze based on the stacks of Heliacal Ember inflicted. Heliacal Ember is capped at {0} stacks, with each stack lasting for {1}s. Heliacal Ember stacks are counted toward the Spectro Frazzle stacks for the Eternal Radiance Sonata Effect.

<size=40><color=Title>Scorching Light</color></size>
When Zani is in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color> become available, which deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> that is considered both Heavy Attack DMG and <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle</color> DMG.
When Blaze is no less than {2}, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Standard Defense Protocol</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Scorching Light</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, during which Zani is immune to interruption. This state ends early when Zani is switched off the field. While in <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, release <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button within a certain time to consume Blaze and perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>.
When attacked in a certain time after entering <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and Stagnate nearby targets, then perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color>, consuming Blazes and further reducing their <te href=850062>Vibration Strength</te> by {3}. Zani's DMG taken within the next {4}s is reduced by {5}.
After casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>, consuming up to {6} Blazes on hit, with each Blaze increasing the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>. If <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 1</color> is interrupted, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> again to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 2</color>.
Upon releasing the button after a certain time or when <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color> ends, immediately perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>.
When Blaze is no less than {2}, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>. After entering <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> immediately replaces the current <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Scorching Light</color>. Hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>.
After performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> immediately to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color> at the cost of Blaze.
After performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>.
If <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is not replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color> after a successful Dodge and Zani has no less than {2} Blazes, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color> at the cost of Blazes.

<size=40><color=Title>Redundant Energy</color></size>
Zani can hold up to 100 Redundant Energy.
Obtain Redundant Energy when Normal Attacks hit a target.
Obtain Redundant Energy when casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Immediate Execution</color>.
Obtain Redundant Energy when casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Standard Defense Protocol</color>.
Obtain Redundant Energy when casting  <color=Highlight>Pinpoint Strike</color>.
Cannot obtain Redundant Energy while in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Blaze</color></size>
Blaze is capped at 100 when not in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>.
Blaze is capped at 150 in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Targeted Action</color> or <color=Highlight>Forcible Riposte</color> grants 10 Blazes.
Every stack of Heliacal Ember converted from <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> grants 5 Blazes.
Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Rekindle</color> grants 50 Blazes.

<size=40><color=Title>Heliacal Ember</color></size>

<size=40><color=Title>Scorching Light</color></size>
Khi Zani ở <color=Highlight>Chế Độ Inferno</color>, các đòn <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color> và <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color> sẽ khả dụng, gây <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> được tính là sát thương Heavy Attack và sát thương <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle</color>.
Khi Blaze không thấp hơn {2}, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Tiêu Chuẩn Defense Protocol</color> sẽ được thay thế bằng Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Scorching Light</color>.

Nếu bị tấn công trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định sau khi vào <color=Highlight>Tư Thế Sẵn Sàng</color>, giảm 100% sát thương nhận vào và làm Trì Hoãn mục tiêu xung quanh, sau đó thực hiện <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color>, tiêu thụ Blaze và giảm thêm {3} <te href=850062>Concerto Vibrancy</te> của chúng. Sát thương Zani nhận trong {4} giây tiếp theo sẽ giảm {5}.
Sau khi thực hiện <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> sẽ được thay thế bằng <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>, tiêu thụ tối đa {6} Blaze khi trúng đích, mỗi Blaze tăng Hệ Số Sát Thương của <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>. Nếu <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 1</color> bị gián đoạn, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> một lần nữa để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 2</color>.
Khi thả nút sau một khoảng thời gian nhất định hoặc khi <color=Highlight>Tư Thế Sẵn Sàng</color> kết thúc, ngay lập tức thực hiện <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>.
Khi Blaze không thấp hơn {2}, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> sẽ được thay thế bằng <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>. Sau khi vào <color=Highlight>Chế Độ Inferno</color>, thực hiện <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> sẽ ngay lập tức thay thế đòn tấn công hiện tại bằng Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Scorching Light</color>. Giữ <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> để vào <color=Highlight>Tư Thế Sẵn Sàng</color>.
Sau khi thực hiện <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> ngay lập tức để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color> với chi phí Blaze.
Sau khi thực hiện <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> sẽ được thay thế bằng <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>.
Nếu <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> không được thay thế bằng <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color> sau khi Dodge thành công và Zani có không ít hơn {2} Blaze, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định để thực hiện <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color> với chi phí Blaze.

<size=40><color=Title>Redundant Energy</color></size>
Zani có thể giữ tối đa 100 Redundant Energy.
Nhận Redundant Energy khi Normal Attack trúng mục tiêu.
Nhận Redundant Energy khi sử dụng Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Immediate Execution</color>.
Nhận Redundant Energy khi sử dụng Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Tiêu Chuẩn Defense Protocol</color>.
Nhận Redundant Energy khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Pinpoint Strike</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Blaze</color></size>
Blaze bị giới hạn ở 100 khi không ở <color=Highlight>Chế Độ Inferno</color>.
Blaze bị giới hạn ở 150 trong <color=Highlight>Chế Độ Inferno</color>.
