<size=40><color=Title>Baseline Mode</color></size>
While in her default <color=Highlight>Baseline Mode</color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Rest Mass Energy</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift</color></size>
When <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Rest Mass Energy</te></color> reaches {0} points, Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift</color>.
Cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift</color> to deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Afterward, Mornye jumps into mid-air, consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Rest Mass Energy</te></color> and enters <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Wide Field Observation Mode</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> lasts for {11}s.
- Upon entering <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye generates a <color=Highlight><te href=120907>Syntony Field</te></color>.
- While in <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color>.
- If <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> is below {0} when holding <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 1 to 3</color> in sequence. If <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> reaches {0} during this time, cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> instead.
- While moving, Mornye continuously consumes STA. STA cannot be recovered while in <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>.
- When <color=Highlight>Dodging</color> with directional input, Mornye starts to fly at speed, which lasts for up to 10s or until STA is depleted or until the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> ends.
- When Mornye is hit or launched into mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to immediately recover from the attack, which is considered a successful Dodge. This effect can be triggered up to {12} times, which resets when <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> ends.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump and Mornye will slowly descend. Before she lands, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> are unavailable. If Jump is {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapped PC=pressed Gamepad=pressed} when Mornye runs out of STA, she will exit the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. She will leave the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> also when she <color=Highlight>Dodges</color>, Jumps, or performs Mid-air Attacks.
Additionally, performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or switching to another Resonator ends <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. The state also ends when Mornye is no longer airborne.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Syntony Field</color></size>
- <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color> lasts for {1}s.
- When the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color> is generated, deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
- Continuously restores HP for nearby active Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color>, triggered once every {2}s.
- Increases the <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Buildup Rate</color> of all nearby Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color> by {3}.
- Enhances the resistance to interruption of nearby active Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color></size>
- When <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> reaches {0} points, Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color>.
- Consume all <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=120905>Observation Marker</te></color> upon the target on hit for {4}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Observation Marker</color></size>
When a Resonator in the team deals <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> DMG to a target inflicted with <color=Highlight>Observation Marker</color>, Mornye inflicts an <color=Highlight><te href=120906>Interfered Marker</te></color> on the target for {5}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Interfered Marker</color></size>
Targets affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> take increased DMG from all nearby Resonators in the team. For every {8} of Mornye's Energy Regen exceeding {7}, their DMG is increased by {9}, up to {10}.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Visual Field</color></size>
When a Resonator in the team defeats a target inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=120905>Observation Marker</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=120906>Interfered Marker</te></color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight>Visual Field</color> for {6}s. While in this state, Mornye inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=120905>Observation Marker</te></color> on the target hit whenever any Resonator in the team deals damage.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet</color></size>
Mornye deals one instance of <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> to targets in the <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> state within range, considered <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Rest Mass Energy</color></size>
Mornye can hold up to {0} points of <color=Highlight>Rest Mass Energy</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120901>Baseline Mode</te></color>, she gains <color=Highlight>Rest Mass Energy</color> when performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, or when <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution</color> hits a target.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Relative Momentum</color></size>
Mornye can hold up to {0} points of <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>, she gains <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color> when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color> hits the target.
Mornye cannot gain <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color> during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Baseline Mode</color></size>
Khi ở <color=Highlight>Baseline Mode</color>, Mornye nhận <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Năng Lượng Khối Lượng Nghỉ</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Shift Địa Thế</color></size>
Khi <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Năng Lượng Khối Lượng Nghỉ</te></color> đạt {0} điểm, Heavy Attack sẽ được thay thế bằng <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Shift Địa Thế</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Wide Field Observation Mode</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> kéo dài trong {11} giây.
- Khi vào <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye tạo ra <color=Highlight><te href=120907>Trường Resonance</te></color>.
- Trong <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye nhận <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color>.

Hiệu ứng này có thể kích hoạt tối đa {12} lần và sẽ được đặt lại khi <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> kết thúc.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Nhảy và Mornye sẽ từ từ hạ xuống. Trước khi cô ấy chạm đất, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Mảng Phân Phối</color> và <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Đảo Chiều</color> sẽ không khả dụng. Nếu Nhảy được {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapped PC=pressed Gamepad=pressed} khi Mornye hết STA, cô ấy sẽ thoát khỏi <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. Cô ấy cũng sẽ rời khỏi chế độ này khi <color=Highlight>Dodge</color>, Nhảy hoặc thực hiện Đòn Mid-air Attack.
Ngoài ra, thực hiện tương tác với môi trường, sử dụng Tiện Ích hoặc chuyển đổi sang Resonators khác sẽ kết thúc <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. Trạng thái này cũng kết thúc khi Mornye không còn ở trên không.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Trường Resonance</color></size>
- <color=Highlight>Trường Resonance</color> kéo dài trong {1} giây.
- Khi <color=Highlight>Trường Resonance</color> được tạo ra, gây <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, được tính là Sát Thương Resonance Liberation.

<size=40><color=Title>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color></size>
Phrolova's max Resonance Energy is 0. <color=Highlight>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color> does not consume Resonance Energy.
When in the <color=Highlight><te href=160802>Resolving Chord</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color> becomes available.
Casting this skill ends the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, and Phrolova enters the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state for {0}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Maestro</color></size>
Gain {5} ATK increase.
Phrolova floats in the air and commands Hecate to fight. Hecate will share Phrolova's stats and statuses, and damage dealt by Hecate will be considered coming from Phrolova. Hecate's attacks will not remove the target's Hazy Dream state.
During this period, Phrolova plays the <color=Highlight><te href=160801>Volatile Notes</te></color> in turn. Each <color=Highlight>Volatile Note</color> holds for {1}s.
If Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, she can give the following cues to Hecate. Any damage taken by Hecate in this state affects Phrolova as well.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Basic Attack</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack to command Hecate to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>. When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, for every {2} times Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>, the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Dodge</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge to command Hecate to dodge an attack. Hecate takes no damage from a hit successfully Dodged.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Reset</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump to reset Hecate's position.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Curtain Call</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Liberation to command Hecate to cast <color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> and end the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.
When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, Hecate takes no damage and automatically casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color> to attack the target. When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color> to attack the target. This effect can be triggered up to {4} times in total during Phrolova's <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state. Echoes of the same name can trigger this effect <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=3}.
Switching back to Phrolova ends <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.
Ending <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state removes all <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Hecate</color></size>
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings</color></size>
When Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Strings</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and Stagnating the targets (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color></size>
When Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Winds</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, pulling the targets in (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza</color></size>
When Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Cadenza</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, Stagnating and pulling the targets in (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Curtain Call</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> can be cast via the following 5 ways, Stagnating the targets and dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, end the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.
- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is not the active Resonator and the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state ends, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation.
- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, hold Resonance Liberation.
When in <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, casting <color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> removes all <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color> and ends the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state.

<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color></size>
Khi Phrolova chơi <color=Highlight>Volatile Ghi chú - Winds</color>, Hecate sẽ sử dụng <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color> khi thực hiện <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, gây <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> và kéo mục tiêu vào (được tính là <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color></size>
By reducing HP to 50% of the Max HP, <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> transforms into <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, unlocking new moves and entering the <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> state for 12s.
Can be performed in mid-air.
Entering <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> clears all <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>.
As <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> instantly trigger 1 instance of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG and reduce the <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> stack on the target hit by 1.
- Ending the state will not clear Resonance Energy.
- No HP cost when HP is below 50%.

<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> attacks restore <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit. When <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> reaches 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color>.

When <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> is below 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to transform back into <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color>. When in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color> as Cartethyia consumes no Resonance Energy.

When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4</color> will generate a force field to Stagnate the targets within the range.
- <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> resistance to interruption increases. 
<color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.

When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>: 
<color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG is Amplified by 50% and the damage interval is decreased by 50% for enemies within a certain distance from <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.
 
When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
When casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color> and <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color> or after <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> deals damage, raise the <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> stacks on all nearby targets to the highest count among the targets.
<color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.
 
<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> will transform back to <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> during <color=Highlight>quest dialogues</color>, <color=Highlight>environmental interaction animations</color>, or using <color=Highlight>Utilities</color>.
<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> can walk on water. Doing so on deep waters continuously consumes STA. When in walking state, <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> can step out of a high place and walk in mid-air by continuously consuming STA.
 
<size=40><color=Title>Avatar - Cartethyia</color></size>
As <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, when <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> is below 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2</color> and temporarily transform back to <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color>, which pauses the timer on <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>.

<color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> unlocks new moves when she transforms into <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>:

<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys</color></size> 
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys</color></size> 
<color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in the air at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.
While airborne, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3</color>.
Follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3</color>.
While airborne, casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> resets the cycle of <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.
Thrust forward to deliver a focused strike, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.

<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color></size>
While casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> again to cast Enhanced <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color>: fall back and blast the area in a straight line in front, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Upward Cut - Fleurdelys</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Upward Cut - Fleurdelys</color></size>
While <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> is on the ground, <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to cast this skill, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys</color></size> 
<color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.
Follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 </color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call</color></size> 
<color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call</color>.
Summon a force field near the target's location to continuously pull in nearby targets, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color></size>
Following <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> again to call down a giant Sword Shadow to crush an area around the target, creating a force field to pull in nearby targets, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to ground targets, and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.
Follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3</color>.
The Resonance Skill enters cooldown if <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> is not cast within a certain period or when switching to another Resonator. 
Can be cast in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle</color></size>
Iuno can activate Lunar Cycle by casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.
Lunar Cycle has two states: <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color> and <color=Highlight>New Moon</color>. By default, Iuno enters the <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color> state when activating Lunar Cycle and can switch between the two states by casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux</color>.
When in Lunar Cycle:
- Iuno's Jump is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux</color>. STA won't recover when Iuno is in mid-air. 
- Iuno's movement becomes <color=Highlight>Meandering</color>, which consumes STA continuously in mid-air to move in a unique manner.
- Performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or holding Jump will end <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color></size>
Iuno attacks using the Moonring, restoring <color=Highlight><te href=141003>Sentience</te></color> on hit.
She can use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow</color> can be cast in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color></size>
Iuno attacks using the Moonbow. While in this state, casting <color=Highlight>Moonbow - Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Arc Beyond the Edge</color>, or <color=Highlight>Moonbow - Dodge Counter</color> consumes <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> to increase the skill's DMG Multiplier, restore additional Concerto Energy, and heal nearby Resonators in the team.
Iuno can use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color>.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color> can be cast in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness</color></size>
When Iuno's Concerto Energy is full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Absolute Fullness</color>.
Casting Absolute Fullness ends <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>, provides healing for nearby Resonators in the team, deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to nearby targets (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG), and conjures a <color=Highlight>Full Moon</color> domain at her location. This effect can be triggered once every 25s.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Full Moon Domain</color></size>
Resonators inside the domain periodically restore  HP and STA.
Gaining a Shield inside the domain grants 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Blessing of the Wan Light</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

<size=40><color=Title>Blessing of the Wan Light</color></size>
The receiving Resonator gains 4% all DMG Amplification for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Gaining new stacks resets the duration. This effect ends early if the receiving Resonator is switched off the field.

<size=40><color=Title>Sentience</color></size>
Iuno can hold up to 100 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
Casting Intro Skill restores 40 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation restores 60 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Unfinished Refrain</color> restores 25 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
When Iuno is in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>, Moonring - Basic Attack, Moonring - Dodge Counter, and Mid-air Attack restore <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> on hit.

[Tower of Adversity]
In the Tower of Adversity, your skills are put to trial. Complete the specific challenge goals to earn your Crests. With enough Crests, you shall collect hefty rewards.

[Zone and Tower]
<color=#c19f51>The Tower of Adversity features four Zones: Stable Zone, Experiment Zone, Hazard Zone, and Overdrive Zone.</color> Each Zone contains one to three Towers, and each Tower has multiple Floors, each representing a unique challenge. Progress through the challenges to unlock new Towers and Zones. Clearing Stable Zone will unlock Experiment Zone, and clearing Experiment Zone will unlock Hazard Zone and Overdrive Zone at the same time.

[Vigor]
In the Tower of Adversity, clearing a challenge reduces participating Resonators' Vigor by a specific amount. Once a Resonator's Vigor is depleted, they can no longer take part in new challenges. <color=#c19f51>Vigor does not restore over time, but you can use the [Reset] option on a Floor to recover the Vigor.</color>

[Area Effects]
In the Tower of Adversity, special environmental effects will influence your combat tactics.

[Trial Phase]
Crest Rewards in the Stable Zone, Experiment Zone, and Overdrive Zone can only be claimed once. <color=#c19f51>However, the challenges in the Hazard Zone are periodically reset, along with your progression, bringing in new enemies, challenge goals, Area Effects, and rewards. Take on the challenges again to earn Crests and claim fresh rewards.</color>

[Record Sync]
Your challenge records for <color=#c19f51>Floor 1-2 of Resonant Tower and Echoing Tower</color> from the previous Trial Phase will be carried over if you earned <color=#c19f51>24</color> Crests in the previous Trial Phase with <color=#c19f51>full Crests</color> in these Floors;
Your challenge records for <color=#c19f51>Floor 1-3 of Resonant Tower and Echoing Tower</color> from the previous Trial phase will be carried over if you earned <color=#c19f51>30</color> Crests in the previous Trial Phase with <color=#c19f51>full Crests</color> in these Floors.

[Zone và Tower]
<color=#c19f51>The Tower of Adversity features four Zones: Stable Zone, Experiment Zone, Hazard Zone, and Overdrive Zone.</color> Mỗi Zone có từ một đến ba Tower, mỗi Tower lại có nhiều Tầng, mỗi Tầng là một thử thách độc đáo. [Sinh lực]
Trong Tower Trial, mỗi lần hoàn thành thử thách sẽ làm giảm một lượng Sinh lực nhất định của Resonators tham gia. Khi Sinh lực của một Resonators cạn kiệt, họ không thể tham gia thử thách mới nữa. <color=#c19f51>Vigor does not restore over time, but you can use the [Đặt lại] option on a Floor to recover the Vigor.</color>

[Hiệu ứng Zone]
Trong Tower Trial, các hiệu ứng môi trường đặc biệt sẽ ảnh hưởng đến chiến thuật chiến đấu của bạn.

[Giai đoạn Trial]
Rewards Huy Hiệu ở Zone Ổn định, Zone Thí nghiệm và Zone Quá tải chỉ có thể nhận một lần. <color=#c19f51>However, the challenges in the Hazard Zone are periodically reset, along with your progression, bringing in new enemies, challenge goals, Area Effects, and rewards. Take on the challenges again to earn Crests and claim fresh rewards.</color>

[Đồng bộ Kỷ lục]

<size=40><color=Title> Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Basic Attack Stage 4 inflicts 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> upon the target hit.
- When the first three stages of Ciaccona's Basic Attack are interrupted by dodging, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Basic Attack in time to resume the attack cycle and cast the corresponding Basic Attack stage.
- After Basic Attack Stage 4, Ciaccona starts a <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>. If Ciaccona's Basic Attack Stage 4 or <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> ends early (proactively or being interrupted), an <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylph</color> is generated.

<size=40><color=Title>Solo Concert</color></size>
When Ciaccona or Ensemble Sylph performs Solo Concert, they give 24% Aero DMG Bonus to all nearby Resonators in the team. This effect is not stackable.

<size=40><color=Title>Ensemble Sylph</color></size>
Up to 2 Ensemble Sylphs may exist simultaneously.
If Ciaccona's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> is interrupted, the Ensemble Sylphs generated will finish the attack for Ciaccona and enter <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>.
If Ciaccona's <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> is interrupted, the <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylphs</color> generated will continue the <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> for Ciaccona.
Aside from the two situations mentioned above, Ensemble Sylphs generated by <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> will finish Ciaccona's current attack without entering <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to jump into mid-air and attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Aimed Attack</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Aim to enter Aiming Mode to fire charged shots, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after Mid-air Attack Stage 2 to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
Follow up successful <color=Highlight>Dodges</color> with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Flashing Thunder Spell - Harmony</color></size>
Tấn công mục tiêu, gây <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> và tạo ra <color=Highlight>Five Thunders Spell Array</color> tại khu vực mục tiêu. Khi <color=Highlight>Five Thunders Spell Array</color> còn hoạt động, tất cả Resonators trong đội bước vào trạng thái <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color>.
- Trong trạng thái <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color>, khi bất kỳ Resonators nào trong đội sử dụng <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color> sẽ chuyển thành <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang</color> tăng {3} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> cho tất cả Resonators đang hoạt động trong đội. Khi bất kỳ Resonators nào trong đội sử dụng <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> trong trạng thái này, <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang</color> sẽ chuyển thành <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Heaven, Earth, Mind</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Heaven, Earth, Mind</color> tăng {4} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> cho tất cả Resonators đang hoạt động trong đội.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Minor Yang and Minor Yin</color></size>

- Tiểu Âm đạt được sau khi sử dụng <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Mirage</color></size>
- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> becomes Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Phantom Sting</color>. Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Can be cast in mid-air. When cast mid-air, Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Phantom Sting</color> consumes STA, and the combo does not reset when Cantarella is airborne.
- Hitting the target with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Phantom Sting</color> consumes {0} point of Trance to obtain {1} point of Shiver and heal all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The third stage of Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Phantom Sting</color> triggers 3 Coordinated Attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Abysmal Vortex</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> becomes Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Shadowy Sweep</color>. Attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after casting the skill to cast Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Phantom Sting Stage 2</color>.
- When Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Abysmal Vortex</color> or Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Shadowy Sweep</color> hits a target, consume {0} point of Trance to obtain {1} point of Shiver and heal all nearby Resonators in the team.
- Mirage lasts for {2}s.
- <color=Highlight>Mirage</color> ends when Trance is depleted.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Forte Circuit - Perception Drain</color></size>
If Cantarella has {3} points of Shiver when in <color=Highlight>Mirage</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Perception Drain</color>.
Consume all Shiver to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG. Send the target into <color=Highlight>Hazy Dream</color> and heal all Resonators in the team.
Casting this skill is also considered as casting <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Abyssal Rebirth</color></size>
After casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, Cantarella enters <color=Highlight>Abyssal Rebirth</color>, which lasts for {5}s and can be activated once every 25s. In the duration, for up to 6 times, when Resonators in the team cast <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color>, Cantarella recovers {4} points of Concerto Energy. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.
When in water, Cantarella's swimming speed increases and STA cost decreases.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Trance</color></size>
- Cantarella can hold up to {6} points of Trance.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> recovers {7} point of Trance.
- Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> recovers {8} point of Trance.
- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Graceful Step</color> recovers {9} point of Trance.
- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Flowing Suffocation</color> recovers {10} points of Trance.
- When in the water, recover {12} point of Trance every {11}s.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Shiver</color></size>
- Cantarella can hold up to {13} points of Shiver.
- Hitting the target with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Phantom Sting</color> recovers {14} point of Shiver.
- When Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Abysmal Vortex</color> or Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>Shadowy Sweep</color> hits a target, restore {15} point of Shiver.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Imminent Oblivion</color></size>
Carlotta activates <color=Highlight>Tinted Crystal</color> every {0}s.
When Substance is full and <color=Highlight>Tinted Crystal</color> is activated, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to consume all Substance and cast Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Imminent Oblivion</color>, after which <color=Highlight>Tinted Crystal</color> enters cooldown.
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and reduce the cooldown of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Art of Violence</color> by {1}s.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Final Bow</color></size>
When Substance is full, enter the <color=Highlight>Final Bow</color> state.
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Era of New Wave </color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Death Knell</color>, and Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fatal Finale</color> by {14}. This effect ends when Carlotta is switched off the field during <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> or when <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> ends.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Substance</color></size>
Carlotta can hold up to {2} points of Substance.
Cannot obtain Substance when in <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color>.
Substance can be obtained in the following ways: Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Wintertime Aria</color>, consuming Moldable Crystals via Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Chromatic Splendor</color>, Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Necessary Measures</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Moldable Crystal</color></size>
Carlotta can hold up to {6} Crystals.
Cannot gain Moldable Crystals while in <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color>.
Moldable Crystal can be obtained in the following ways: <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Customary Greetings</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Art of Violence</color>, and a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color>.

Obtain {4} Performance Capacity when Stage 1 of Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Pivot - Impale</color> hits a target.

<color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> lasts for {11}s.
- Upon entering <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye generates a <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color>.
- While in <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color>.
- If <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color> is below {0} when holding <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 1 to 3</color> in sequence. If <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color> reaches {0} during this time, cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> instead.
- While moving, Mornye continuously consumes STA. STA cannot be recovered while in <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>.
- When Dodging with directional input, Mornye starts to fly at speed, which lasts for up to 10s or until STA is depleted or until the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> ends.
- When Mornye is hit or launched into mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Dodge to immediately recover from the attack, which is considered a successful Dodge. This effect can be triggered up to {12} times, which resets when <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> ends.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump and Mornye will slowly descend. Before she lands, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> are unavailable. If Jump is {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapped PC=pressed Gamepad=pressed} when Mornye runs out of STA, she will exit the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. She will leave the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> also when she <color=Highlight>Dodges</color>, Jumps, or performs Mid-air Attacks.
Additionally, performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or switching to another Resonator ends <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. The state also ends when Mornye is no longer airborne.

[About]
The Black Shores has developed a special training program that can simulate dangerous trials in Solaris by using Tethys system data. The program is a good measure of the challenger's combat capabilities under adverse conditions.
 
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 30.
 
[Crisis Trials]
As a member of the Black Shores, take on trials under a selection of Stress Modules.
Select a Stress Level for each trial. The Stress Level must meet the requirements to complete the trial.
Each trial has a default Stress Module. Support Modules are available to lower the trial's difficulty.
After completing a Crisis Trial, the corresponding Disaster Trial along with its Stress Module and Support Module will be unlocked.
 
[Disaster Trials]
To gather additional combat data and improve the Black Shores's crisis response plans, this training program also includes a Hard Mode.
As a member of the Black Shores, you will face <color=#c89a45>hard challenges</color> with various Stress Module combinations.
Disaster Trials have no required Stress Level. Data samples are gathered from participants pushing their limits.
Participating in a Disaster Trial will consume Support Modules, so select them carefully in advance.
Certain high-difficulty Stress Modules can only be unlocked after clearing a Disaster Trial.
<color=#c89a45>Warning: Equipping too many Stress Modules may make the trial excessively challenging.</color>
 
[Revival Mechanism]
If a participant is downed in a trial, they can consume Stress Levels to revive. This also gives a corresponding buff.
Please note that consuming Stress Levels will affect the completion and final result of Challenge Goals.

[Matrix Crystals]
Obtain Matrix Crystals by completing Challenge Goals in the Crisis and Disaster Trials. Matrix Crystals can be exchanged for rewards at the Supply Station. Completing certain Stress Level challenges in Disaster Trials will grant an <color=#c89a45>event-exclusive Title reward</color>.
<color=#c89a45>The Supply Station closes when this event ends. All remaining Matrix Crystals will expire and will not be reserved after the event ends. Please exchange your Matrix Crystals in time.</color>
vn_translate:
[Giới thiệu]
Bờ Đen đã phát triển một chương trình huấn luyện đặc biệt có thể mô phỏng các thử thách nguy hiểm tại Solaris bằng cách sử dụng dữ liệu hệ thống Tethys. Chương trình này là thước đo hiệu quả về năng lực chiến đấu của người tham gia trong điều kiện bất lợi.

[Điều kiện tham gia]
Đạt Cấp Liên Minh 30.

[Thử thách Khủng hoảng]
Với tư cách thành viên Bờ Đen, bạn sẽ đối mặt với các thử thách dưới nhiều Stress Modules khác nhau.
Chọn Mức Độ Áp Lực cho mỗi thử thách. Mức Độ Áp Lực phải đáp ứng yêu cầu để hoàn thành thử thách.
Mỗi thử thách có một Stress Modules mặc định. Các Hỗ Trợ Mô-đun có thể được sử dụng để giảm độ khó của thử thách.
Sau khi hoàn thành một Thử thách Khủng hoảng, Thử thách Thảm họa tương ứng cùng Stress Modules và Hỗ Trợ Mô-đun sẽ được mở khóa.

[Thử thách Thảm họa]
Để thu thập thêm dữ liệu chiến đấu và cải thiện kế hoạch ứng phó khủng hoảng của Bờ Đen, chương trình huấn luyện này còn bao gồm Chế độ Khó.
Với tư cách thành viên Bờ Đen, bạn sẽ đối mặt với <color=#c89a45>hard challenges</color> với nhiều tổ hợp Stress Modules khác nhau.
Thử thách Thảm họa không yêu cầu Mức Độ Áp Lực cụ thể. Dữ liệu sẽ được thu thập từ những người tham gia khi họ đẩy giới hạn của bản thân.
Tham gia Thử thách Thảm họa sẽ tiêu hao Hỗ Trợ Mô-đun, vì vậy hãy lựa chọn cẩn thận trước khi bắt đầu.
Một số Stress Modules có độ khó cao chỉ có thể mở khóa sau khi vượt qua Thử thách Thảm họa.
<color=#c89a45>Warning: Equipping too many Stress Modules may make the trial excessively challenging.</color>

[Cơ chế hồi sinh]
Nếu người tham gia bị đánh bại trong thử thách, họ có thể tiêu hao Mức Độ Áp Lực để hồi sinh. Điều này cũng mang lại hiệu ứng tăng cường tương ứng.

<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Cartethyia</color></size>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Following <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia</color> Stage 4, inflict 1 stack of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on targets hit and summon <color=Highlight><te href=850186>Sword of Divinity's Shadow</te></color>.
Up to 1 <color=Highlight><te href=850186>Sword of Divinity's Shadow</te></color> may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.
 
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Cartethyia</color></size> 
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and summoning <color=Highlight><te href=850185>Sword of Discord's Shadow</te></color>. Can be performed in mid-air.
Up to 1 <color=Highlight><te href=850185>Sword of Discord's Shadow</te></color> may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.
This instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color></size>
Release <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button while airborne to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, also considered <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after the <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color> recalls all <color=Highlight>Sword Shadows</color>. Based on the types and number of <color=Highlight> Sword Shadows</color> recalled, perform different forms of Plunging Attack and obtain the corresponding <color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color>, and <color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Cartethyia</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle</color></size>
Iuno can activate Lunar Cycle by casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.
Lunar Cycle has two states: <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color> and <color=Highlight>New Moon</color>. Iuno switches states when she Jumps.
<color=Highlight>Half Moon</color>: Attack with Moonring, restoring <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> on hit. 
<color=Highlight>New Moon</color>: Attack with Moonbow, consuming <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> to increase DMG, restore additional Concerto Energy, and heal nearby Resonators in the team.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness</color></size>
When Iuno's Concerto Energy is full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Absolute Fullness</color>.
Casting Absolute Fullness heals nearby Resonators, deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to targets nearby and conjures a <color=Highlight>Full Moon Domain</color> at her location.
Resonators inside the <color=Highlight>Full Moon Domain</color> periodically restore HP and STA. Gaining a Shield inside the domain grants 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Blessing of the Wan Light</color>, which grants 4% all DMG Amplification for the receiving Resonator, stacking up to 10 times.

<size=40><color=Title>Sentience</color></size>
Iuno restores <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> upon casting Intro Skill, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Unfinished Refrain</color>.
When Iuno hits a target in <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color>, she restores <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.

[About]
The Somnoire gateway suddenly appears in Lahai-Roi, along with a bizarre, tangled dreamscape. Somehow, you even see Namipon in the midst of this chaos...

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and unlock the Resonance Nexus of the Startorch Academy during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands."

[Event Rules]
1. After the event begins, speak with Namipon at Startorch Academy to accept the quest and start the challenge.
2. The challenge features three "Surface of Illusions" stages and one "Depth of Illusions" stage. Before entering, you can adjust the reward rate via Memetic Tuning. Higher rates yield greater rewards. Clearing stages earns you Illusive Specimen and Memory Points.
3. Illusive Specimens can be used to exchange for Astrites and other rewards. 
4. Spend Memory Points in Thought Revolution to upgrade your abilities, making future challenges easier.
4. Collect powerful boosts such as Illusive Echoes, Metaphors, and Resonator Enhancements as you venture through the Somnoire. Build the ultimate combination to conquer the deepest reaches of the dreamscape.

※ You may explore the Illusive Realm with the following Resonators:
※ Resonators available: Luuk Herssen, Aemeath, Mornye, Lynae, Chisa, Qiuyuan, Galbrena, Iuno, Augusta, Phrolova, Lupa, Cartethyia, Ciaccona, Zani, Cantarella, Brant, Phoebe, Roccia, Carlotta, Camellya, Shorekeeper, Xiangli Yao, Zhezhi, Changli, Jinhsi, Yinlin, Jiyan, Calcharo, Lingyang, Jianxin, Verina, Encore, Rover: Aero, Rover: Havoc, Rover: Spectro, Buling, Lumi, Youhu, Yuanwu, Danjin, Sanhua, Mortefi, Taoqi, Aalto, Baizhi, Yangyang, and Chixia.
※ The selected Resonator's level, Resonance Chain, and weapon will be carried over in the Illusive Realm, but their Echo stats and Echo skill will not.
※ The selected Resonator's Outfit will not be displayed in certain screens while exploring the Illusive Realm.

Về sự kiện
Cánh cổng Somnoire đột nhiên xuất hiện ở Lahai-Roi, kéo theo một giấc mơ hỗn độn, rối rắm. Kỳ lạ thay, ngay trong hỗn loạn ấy, ngươi còn thấy cả Namipon...

Điều kiện tham gia
Đạt Cấp Liên Minh 14 và mở Khối Liên Kết Resonance của Học Viện Startorch trong Nhiệm Vụ Chính "Điều Gì Nung Nấu Dưới Băng Giá".

Quy tắc sự kiện
1. Sau khi sự kiện bắt đầu, nói chuyện với Namipon tại Học Viện Startorch để nhận nhiệm vụ và bắt đầu thử thách.
2. Thử thách gồm ba giai đoạn "Surface of Illusions" và một giai đoạn "Độ Sâu Ảo Ảnh". Trước khi vào, ngươi có thể điều chỉnh tỷ lệ phần thưởng qua Tuning Tần Số. Tỷ lệ càng cao, phần thưởng càng lớn. Hoàn thành các giai đoạn sẽ nhận được Mẫu Ảo và Memory Points.
3. Dùng Mẫu Ảo để đổi lấy Astrites và các phần thưởng khác.
4. Tiêu Memory Points trong Cuộc Cách Mạng Tư Tưởng để nâng cấp khả năng, giúp các thử thách sau dễ dàng hơn.
5. Thu thập các hiệu ứng tăng cường mạnh mẽ như Echoes Ảo, Ẩn Dụ và Resonators Enhancements khi khám phá Somnoire. Xây dựng tổ hợp tối ưu để chinh phục những tầng sâu nhất của giấc mơ.

[Event Update: Phantasm Amass]
New Resonators available: Camellya, Lumi, Youhu, Shorekeeper, Encore, Verina, Calcharo, Lingyang, and Mortefi.
Exclusive level boosts will be available in Thought Evolution. Activate corresponding bonuses to increase all Resonators' levels in the Illusive Realm.

Explore all-new scenes and face off against new enemies! Step into the ever-shifting dreamscapes and uncover the secrets that lie within!

[Exploration]
Embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm and choose your Resonator from a diverse pool including Rover: Spectro, Yangyang, Chixia, Baizhi, Taoqi, Jiyan, Yinlin, Jianxin, Sanhua, Jinhsi, Changli, Xiangli Yao, Zhezhi, Yuanwu, Danjin, Camellya, Lumi, Youhu, Shorekeeper, Encore, Verina, Calcharo, Lingyang, and Mortefi.
The Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators may be carried over in the event but the Echo Skills and Stats will be ineffective.
Utilize powerful boosts such as Illusive Echoes, Metaphor, Character Enhancement, and Token to defeat challenging enemy combinations.
Collect Metaphors to unlock unique skills of the Illusive Echoes for the Resonators.
With higher levels of difficulty, each playthrough offers new challenges and rewards. As you progress through the levels, higher difficulties and better rewards become available in the Illusive Store.

Symphony Rank is activated during battle.
All combat actions will progressively raise your Symphony Rank, while being attacked will significantly lower it.
During battles, if you do not achieve a Symphony Rank within a specified period, your Symphony Rank will decrease over time.

Symphony Rank is categorized into 6 tiers: D, C, B, A, S, and SS. If you achieve Rank A or higher, you'll obtain special buffs.
Rank A: Dodge Counter DMG is increased by 100%.
Rank S: After performing a Dodge Counter, the Cooldown of all skills is reduced by 30%.
Rank SS: Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG are increased by 100%, and your Symphony Rank will not drop below SS for a brief time.

[Thought Evolution]
By successfully navigating through Illusive Realm, you can earn valuable Memory Points. These points can then be used in Thought Evolution to unlock powerful enhancements, ultimately making the Resonator a force to be reckoned with in the Illusive Realm.

[Anomaly Investigation]
Complete the exploration under designated conditions to unlock exclusive achievements and rewards.

[Illusive Store]
Complete the exploration of the Illusive Realm to earn Illusive Specimens and exchange them for exclusive rewards in the Illusive Store.
Illusive Specimens will expire at the end of each event period, so don't forget to use them in time.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the dream mass found at the deepest parts of the realm. Use Reward Attempts to collect its rewards.
Remnant Crystal Reward Attempts reset every Monday at 04:00 A.M. server time.
The Remnant Crystal grants equal rewards across all Phantasm Amass difficulties.

[Khám Phá]
Tham gia những trận chiến hoành tráng trong Ảo Cảnh Giới và lựa chọn Resonators từ danh sách đa dạng bao gồm Rover: Spectro, Yangyang, Chixia, Baizhi, Taoqi, Jiyan, Yinlin, Jianxin, Sanhua, Jinhsi, Changli, Xiangli Yao, Zhezhi, Yuanwu, Danjin, Camellya, Lumi, Youhu, Shorekeeper, Encore, Verina, Calcharo, Lingyang và Mortefi.

Hạng Giao Hưởng được kích hoạt trong trận chiến.
Mọi hành động chiến đấu sẽ dần nâng cao Hạng Giao Hưởng của bạn, trong khi bị tấn công sẽ làm giảm đáng kể.
Trong trận chiến, nếu không đạt được Hạng Giao Hưởng trong khoảng thời gian quy định, Hạng Giao Hưởng sẽ giảm dần theo thời gian.

Bằng cách vượt qua Ảo Cảnh Giới, bạn có thể kiếm được Memory Points quý giá. Những điểm này có thể được sử dụng trong Tiến Hóa Ý Niệm để mở khóa những tăng cường mạnh mẽ, biến Resonators trở thành một thế lực đáng gờm trong Ảo Cảnh Giới.

[Anomaly Investigation]
Hoàn thành khám phá theo điều kiện chỉ định để mở khóa thành tựu và phần thưởng độc quyền.

[Illusive Cửa hàng]
Hoàn thành khám phá Ảo Cảnh Giới để kiếm được Illusive Specimen và đổi lấy phần thưởng độc quyền trong Illusive Cửa hàng.

en_source:
About Map Exploration
 
[Events]
There are various types of events on the map, each with the following effects:
Story Event: A mandatory event required to progress, including the main story and final challenge.
Battle Event: Engage in battle and earn Dream Fragments based on the battle's difficulty.
Random Event: Trigger different outcomes.
Recruitment Event: Spend Dream Fragments to recruit Resonators.
Respite Event: Restore Film Rolls.
 
[Film Roll]
Film Rolls are consumed by Battle Events, Random Events, and Story Events.
If you are defeated in a battle, use Film Rolls to restore your Resonators to their pre-battle state.
 
[Bond]
Bonds can be formed between certain Resonators, and a Resonator can hold multiple Bonds.
Bonds provide combat buffs that apply to all Resonators unless specified otherwise.
Bond Level is based on the Star Ratings of all Resonators sharing the same Bond.
Increase the Bond Level to unlock its unique Synergy Burst.

[Synergy Burst]
When three Resonators with the same Bond are in the team, their Synergy Burst is triggered, providing the following effects:
1. Targets are immediately immobilized.
2. Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation Cooldown are reset. Resonance Energy is recovered and 100 Concerto Energy is restored.
vn_translate:
Về Khám Phá Map
 
[Events]
Trên bản đồ có nhiều loại sự kiện khác nhau, mỗi loại mang lại hiệu ứng như sau:
Events Cốt Truyện: Events bắt buộc để tiến triển, bao gồm cốt truyện chính và thử thách cuối.
Battle Event: Tham gia chiến đấu và nhận Dream Fragments dựa trên độ khó của trận đánh.
Random Event: Trigger các kết quả khác nhau.
Events Tuyển Mộ: Dùng Dream Fragments để tuyển Synergy Giả.
Events Nghỉ Ngơi: Khôi phục Film Cuộn.
 
[Film Cuộn]
Film Cuộn bị tiêu hao trong Battle Event, Random Event và Events Cốt Truyện.
Nếu bị đánh bại trong trận chiến, dùng Film Cuộn để đưa Synergy Giả về trạng thái trước khi giao tranh.
 
[Bond]
Một số Synergy Giả có thể hình thành Bond, và một Synergy Giả có thể có nhiều Bond.
Bond mang lại hiệu ứng tăng cường chiến đấu áp dụng cho tất cả Synergy Giả trừ khi có quy định khác.
Cấp Độ Bond dựa trên Xếp Hạng Sao của tất cả Synergy Giả cùng chia sẻ Bond đó.
Increase Cấp Độ Bond để mở khóa Kỹ Năng Đồng Điệu Đặc Biệt.

[Kỹ Năng Đồng Điệu]
Khi có ba Synergy Giả cùng Bond trong đội, Kỹ Năng Đồng Điệu của họ sẽ được kích hoạt, mang lại các hiệu ứng sau:
1. Mục tiêu bị bất động ngay lập tức.
2. Cooldown chiêu của Kỹ Năng Synergy và Giải Phóng Synergy được đặt lại. Năng Lượng Synergy được phục hồi và 100 Concerto Energy được khôi phục.

...
 
The Roya once walked the surface, on ancient plains where the Glommoths and Glommothas thundered in their thousands. In the subarctic fjords, their ancestors lived as nomads, and even now, the shepherd's instinct still flows in their blood.
 
Within Roya society, three distinguished callings exist: the Shepherd, the Solsworn, and the Heliodic Six. Those recognized by the Soliskin become Shepherds, tasked with tending to the Exoswarm in their growth and renewal. Only those gifted in reckoning calendars and possessing a degree of resonance with both Soliskin and the Exostrider may enter the Solisylum, there to be named among the Solsworns. These Solsworns also stand as potential successors to the Heliodic Six.
 
Thus, gaining the acknowledgment of the Soliskin and Exoswarm is essential, whether one seeks to become a Shepherd, a Solsworn, or one of the Heliodic Six. To the Roya, the Soliskin, the Exoswarm, and all living beings in Lahai-Roi hold profound importance. Respect for life and reverence for the world shaped by the Exostrider's Reactor Drive is a lesson every Roya must master upon coming of age.
 
...
 
Within the vast underground cavern of Lahai-Roi lies Bjartr Woods, one of the rare regions untouched by the ravages of Void Storms. It is here that the Roya built the Solisylum. In ordinary seasons, they guide the Exoswarm in their growth and migration, while during periods of intense Void Storm activity, they cease shepherding and lead the Exoswarm to shelter within the Solisylum.
 
When an Exoswarm reaches full maturity, it joins a great migration. Its final destination is the Exostrider slumbering in the frostlands. The Exoswarm offer up their components to repair this ancient mecha form.
 
Beyond safeguarding Exoswarm parts, the Solisylum also serves as the central hub of data and records. Roya from every settlement bring their observational data here, where the Heliodic Six and their assisting Solsworns compile and calculate it. Each season, they determine whether the Reactor Drive remains stable, how many new Exoswarm have emerged and matured, and how many have completed their return to the Exostrider.
 
Once this information is consolidated, the Heliodic Six establishes the next season's calendar based on the Reactor Drive's activity, thereby charting the future focus of all Royan life and work.
vn_translate:
...
 
Ngày xưa, tộc Roya từng lang thang trên mặt đất, nơi những đồng bằng cổ xưa vang vọng tiếng gầm rú của hàng ngàn Glommoth và Glommotha. Tại những vịnh hẹp băng giá phương bắc, tổ tiên họ sống đời du mục, và đến tận bây giờ, bản năng chăn giữ vẫn chảy trong huyết quản của họ.
 
Trong xã hội Roya, tồn tại ba thiên chức cao quý: Người Chăn Giữ, Solsworn, và Lục Hào Quang. Những ai được Soliskin công nhận sẽ trở thành Người Chăn Giữ, có nhiệm vụ chăm sóc Exoswarm trong quá trình sinh trưởng và tái sinh. Chỉ những ai tinh thông lịch pháp và có khả năng cộng hưởng với cả Soliskin lẫn Exostrider mới được bước vào Solisylum, nơi họ được tôn xưng là Solsworn. Những Solsworn này cũng chính là ứng viên kế vị Lục Hào Quang.
 
Vì vậy, việc được Soliskin và Exoswarm thừa nhận là điều tối quan trọng, dù bạn muốn trở thành Người Chăn Giữ, Solsworn, hay một trong Lục Hào Quang. Đối với tộc Roya, Soliskin, Exoswarm, và mọi sinh linh ở Lahai-Roi đều mang ý nghĩa sâu sắc. Tôn trọng sự sống và kính ngưỡng thế giới được định hình bởi Reactor Drive của Exostrider là bài học mà mỗi người Roya phải thấm nhuần khi trưởng thành.
 
...
 
Nằm sâu trong hang động ngầm rộng lớn của Lahai-Roi là Bjartr Woods, một trong số ít vùng đất còn nguyên vẹn trước sự tàn phá của Void Storm. Chính tại đây, tộc Roya đã xây dựng Solisylum. Vào những mùa bình thường, họ dẫn dắt Exoswarm trong quá trình sinh trưởng và di cư, còn khi Void Storm hoạt động dữ dội, họ ngừng chăn giữ và đưa Exoswarm vào trú ẩn trong Solisylum.
 
Khi một Exoswarm trưởng thành hoàn toàn, nó sẽ tham gia cuộc di cư vĩ đại. Điểm đến cuối cùng là Exostrider đang yên giấc trong vùng băng giá. Exoswarm sẽ hiến dâng các bộ phận của mình để sửa chữa cỗ máy cổ đại này.
 
Ngoài việc bảo vệ các bộ phận của Exoswarm, Solisylum còn là trung tâm dữ liệu và lưu trữ hồ sơ. Người Roya từ khắp các khu định cư mang dữ liệu quan sát của mình đến đây, nơi Lục Hào Quang và các Solsworn phụ tá tổng hợp và tính toán. Mỗi mùa, họ xác định liệu Reactor Drive có còn ổn định, bao nhiêu Exoswarm mới xuất hiện và trưởng thành, cũng như bao nhiêu con đã hoàn thành hành trình trở về với Exostrider.
 
Sau khi tổng hợp thông tin, Lục Hào Quang sẽ thiết lập lịch cho mùa tiếp theo dựa trên hoạt động của Reactor Drive, từ đó định hướng cuộc sống và công việc của toàn thể tộc Roya.

[About]
Guided by the orbit, led by luck, and fueled by romanticism.
This is the great adventure—a vibrant trek across the galaxy.
Time to let the sea of stars bounce in rhythm with your heart!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14, and activate the Startorch Academy Resonance Nexus during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock (complete "Gold Suspended in Shadows" for a better experience).

[Rules]
1. Access the game in the Mind Dive Arcade or the event page and start your adventure in the infinite galaxy of Star Bouncing.
2. Along the way, you can collect various Persona Pinballs and use them to build different lineups to take on your foes.
3. Level up your Persona Pinballs and gather powerful Tactical ROMs to strengthen your team as you progress. Stronger enemies await, bringing even greater rewards.
4. Any unclaimed rewards will be sent to your in-game mailbox automatically if you log in within 30 days after the event ends.

[Instructions]
1. Bounce DMG: Collide with an enemy to deal Bounce DMG based on the Pinball’s ATK.
2. Skill Energy: Each Pinball can hold up to 600 points of Skill Energy. Casting a Skill costs exactly 600 points.
3. Rush Energy: The team shares up to 400 points of Rush Energy. Every launch from the Flippers restores 200 points.
4. Combo & Power Strike: Dealing Bounce DMG adds to your Combo hit count. At 5, 10, or 25 hits, your next launch becomes a Level 1, 2, or 3 Power Strike, dealing Power Strike DMG based on the Leader Pinball's ATK.
5. Burst: The team can hold up to 500 Burst Points. When the Burst Gauge is full, activate the following effects for a limited time:
(1) Collision with an enemy deals Power Strike DMG based on the Leader Pinball's ATK and increases the Combo hit count by 1.
(2) Directional Bounce mechanisms appear. Touching them sends the Pinball Rushing in a set direction, dealing Rush DMG based on the Leader Pinball's ATK.
(3) The team regenerates more Skill Energy every second. 
(4) The team's Movement Speed is increased by 20%.

Về sự kiện
Được dẫn dắt bởi quỹ đạo, may mắn và ngọn lửa lãng mạn.
Đây chính là chuyến phiêu lưu vĩ đại - một hành trình rực rỡ xuyên qua dải ngân hà.
Đến lúc để biển sao nhảy múa theo nhịp đập trái tim bạn!

Điều kiện tham gia
Đạt Cấp Liên Minh 14 và kích hoạt Resonance Nexus của Startorch Academy trong Nhiệm Vụ Chính "Điều Âm Ỉm Dưới Lớp Băng Giá" để mở khóa (hoàn thành "Vàng Đọng Trong Bóng Tối" để có trải nghiệm tốt hơn).

Quy tắc
1. Truy cập trò chơi trong Mind Dive Arcade hoặc trang sự kiện và bắt đầu cuộc phiêu lưu trong thiên hà vô tận của Star Bouncing.
2. Trên đường đi, bạn có thể thu thập nhiều loại Persona Pinball khác nhau và sử dụng chúng để xây dựng đội hình đối phó kẻ thù.
3. Nâng cấp Persona Pinball và thu thập các Tactical ROM mạnh mẽ để củng cố đội hình khi tiến xa hơn. Kẻ thù càng mạnh, phần thưởng càng hấp dẫn.
4. Nếu đăng nhập trong vòng 30 ngày sau khi sự kiện kết thúc, mọi phần thưởng chưa nhận sẽ tự động gửi vào hộp thư trong game.

Hướng dẫn
1. Sát thương Bật: Va chạm với kẻ địch để gây Sát thương Bật dựa trên Tấn Công của Pinball.
2. Năng lượng Skill: Mỗi Pinball có thể chứa tối đa 600 điểm Năng lượng Skill. Sử dụng Skill tiêu tốn chính xác 600 điểm.
3. Năng lượng Tốc Rush: Đội hình chia sẻ tối đa 400 điểm Năng lượng Tốc Rush. Mỗi lần phóng từ Flipper sẽ hồi 200 điểm.
4. Combo & Đòn Quyền Năng: Gây Sát thương Bật sẽ tăng số hit Combo. Khi đạt 5, 10 hoặc 25 hit, lần phóng tiếp theo sẽ trở thành Đòn Quyền Năng Cấp 1, 2 hoặc 3, gây Sát thương Quyền Năng dựa trên Tấn Công của Pinball Đội trưởng.
5. Kích Nổ: Đội hình có thể chứa tối đa 500 điểm Kích Nổ. Khi thanh Kích Nổ đầy, kích hoạt các hiệu ứng sau trong thời gian giới hạn:
(1) Va chạm với kẻ địch gây Sát thương Quyền Năng dựa trên Tấn Công của Pinball Đội trưởng và tăng số hit Combo lên 1.
(2) Cơ chế Bật Hướng xuất hiện. Chạm vào chúng sẽ khiến Pinball Tốc Rush theo hướng định sẵn, gây Sát thương Rush dựa trên Tấn Công của Pinball Đội trưởng.
(3) Đội hình hồi Năng lượng Skill nhanh hơn mỗi giây.
(4) Tốc độ Di chuyển của đội hình tăng 20%.

[About]
During the event, obtain Moonlit Rings to unlock and claim rewards. Purchase merchandise tagged with <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiActivity/Image/Activity31/CumulativeRecharge/Common/T_TempScoreIcon.T_TempScoreIcon,0.5/> in the <color=#ad893a>Recommended - Weekly Subscription, Recommended - Lunite Subscription, Bundles - Special Offers, Outfits - Vehicle Looks, and the Lunite Purchase</color> sections of the Store to obtain Moonlit Rings.

When the Moonlit Path event ends, the Moonlit Rings will expire and will not be converted to other items. After the event ends, any unclaimed event rewards will be reissued via in-game mail if you log in within 30 days. If you fail to log in within 30 days, the rewards will not be reissued. Don't forget to claim them in your in-game mailbox.

[Eligibility]
- Reach Union Level 5.
- Or complete the combat trial in the Main Quest "First Resonance."
- Or access Main Quest Fast Track Event and proceed with the Main Quest until you reach a specific point.

[Rules]
During the event, obtain Moonlit Rings to unlock and claim rewards.

Log in and enter Moonlit Path to claim: Lustrous Tide x1
Obtain 30 Moonlit Rings to claim: Radiant Tide x1
Obtain 88 Moonlit Rings to claim: Motorbike Accessory - Little Savior
Obtain 198 Moonlit Rings to claim: Forging Tide x2
Obtain 328 Moonlit Rings to claim: Custom Livery - Singer in Deepspace (Full set includes: Left Fender, Right Fender, Front/Rear)
Obtain 450 Moonlit Rings to claim: 5-star Weapon Supply Chest - Synth Armament x1 (Open to choose one weapon: Laser Shearer, Radiance Cleaver, Phasic Homogenizer, Pulsation Bracer, or Boson Astrolabe)
Obtain 680 Moonlit Rings to claim: Transducer x3
Obtain 980 Moonlit Rings to claim: Stellar Anchor of Memories x 1 (Exchanged for Shorekeeper, Camellya, or Jinhsi, or Transducer x8)
Obtain 1600 Moonlit Rings to claim: Cosmetics Set x1 (Full set includes Avatar: Choir of Stars, Sigil: Favor of Stars, Custom Accessory: Starbright Resonance)

[Note]
- If you make purchases through any non–in-game channel, such as the official website's top-up center, please log in to the game while the event is ongoing to receive your purchases, as well as the corresponding Moonlit Rings. If you log in after the event ends, you will not receive the corresponding Moonlit Rings.

Trong sự kiện, thu thập Nhẫn Ánh Trăng để mở khóa và nhận phần thưởng. - Đạt Cấp Liên Minh 5.

Thu thập 328 Nhẫn Ánh Trăng để nhận: Mẫu Sơn Xe Tùy Chỉnh - Ca Sĩ Vùng Sâu (Bộ đầy đủ gồm: Cánh Trái, Cánh Right, Trước/Sau)
Thu thập 450 Nhẫn Ánh Trăng để nhận: 5-star Weapon Supply Chest - Vũ Khí Tổng Hợp x1 (Mở để chọn một trong các vũ khí: Laser Shearer, Radiance Cleaver, Phasic Homogenizer, Pulsation Bracer, hoặc Boson Astrolabe)
Thu thập 680 Nhẫn Ánh Trăng để nhận: Transducer x3

Thu thập 1600 Nhẫn Ánh Trăng để nhận: Bộ Trang Phục x1 (Bộ đầy đủ gồm: Hình Đại Diện: Dàn Hợp Xướng Sao, Huy Hiệu: Ân Huệ Của Sao, Phụ Kiện Tùy Chỉnh: Starbright Resonance)

- Nếu bạn mua hàng qua bất kỳ kênh nào không phải trong game, như trung tâm nạp tiền trên trang web chính thức, vui lòng đăng nhập vào game khi sự kiện đang diễn ra để nhận đơn hàng và số Nhẫn Ánh Trăng tương ứng. Nếu đăng nhập sau khi sự kiện kết thúc, bạn sẽ không nhận được Nhẫn Ánh Trăng tương ứng.

[Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot]
In Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot, your skills will be tested through multiple challenging stages. Confront the enemies and earn points to claim corresponding rewards.

[Eligibility]
Achieve at least 24 Crests in one phase of the Tower of Adversity and reach at least 3,500 points in one phase of the Respawning Waters: Torrents in Whimpering Wastes after 3.0 is released.

[Matrix]
Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot consists of two Zones: Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion. Earn the required points in Stability Accords to unlock Singularity Expansion.

[Stability Accords]
You may deploy up to 3 teams. Defeat all enemies in one round to complete the challenge.

[Singularity Expansion]
There is no limit to the number of teams you can deploy. Defeating all enemies in a round will open the next round, with enemies growing stronger each time.

[Power Circuits]
In Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot, you must deploy three Resonators in each team and select a Power Circuit before starting the challenge.

[Demo Resonators]
Demo Resonators are available only if you own the corresponding Resonators. Each Demo Resonator is set to Lv. 90, equipped with a Lv. 90 weapon and a fitting Echo set with Lv. 25 Echoes . They inherit the Resonance Chain from your own Resonators.

[Resonator Enhancements]
In Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot, certain Resonators will receive special skill enhancements.

[Viral Infection]
In Singularity Expansion, enemy HP increases by each round, and stronger enemy effects will be unlocked as rounds progress.

[Vigor]
Each time a Resonator participates in a challenge, 1 point of Vigor is consumed. Resonators with 0 Vigor cannot be deployed. Vigor is calculated separately for Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion.

[Weapon & Echo Occupation]
Different Resonators cannot use the same weapon and Echo in this event. If a Resonator in the team has equipped a weapon or Echo used by another Resonator with a challenge record, you cannot start the challenge with this team.
vn_translate:
[Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot]
Trong Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot, kỹ năng của bạn sẽ được thử thách qua nhiều giai đoạn khó khăn. Đối đầu với kẻ địch và kiếm điểm để nhận những phần thưởng tương ứng.

[Điều Kiện Tham Gia]
Đạt ít nhất 24 Huy Hiệu trong một giai đoạn của Tower of Adversity và đạt ít nhất 3.500 điểm trong một giai đoạn của Dòng Nước Hồi Sinh: Thác Nước Trong Whimpering Wastes tại Whimpering Wastes sau khi phiên bản 3.0 ra mắt.

[Ma Trận]
Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot gồm hai Khu Vực: Stability Accords và Singularity Expansion. Kiếm đủ điểm yêu cầu trong Stability Accords để mở khóa Singularity Expansion.

[Stability Accords]
Bạn có thể triển khai tối đa 3 đội. Đánh bại tất cả kẻ địch trong một vòng để hoàn thành thử thách.

[Singularity Expansion]
Không giới hạn số đội bạn có thể triển khai. Đánh bại tất cả kẻ địch trong một vòng sẽ mở vòng tiếp theo, với kẻ địch ngày càng mạnh hơn.

[Power Circuits]
Trong Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot, mỗi đội phải triển khai ba Resonators và chọn một Power Circuit trước khi bắt đầu thử thách.

[Demo Resonators]
Demo Resonators chỉ khả dụng nếu bạn sở hữu Resonators tương ứng. Mỗi Demo Resonators được đặt ở cấp 90, trang bị vũ khí cấp 90 và bộ Echoes phù hợp với Echoes cấp 25. Họ kế thừa Resonance Chain từ Resonators của bạn.

[Resonators Enhancements]
Trong Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot, một số Resonators sẽ nhận được tăng cường kỹ năng đặc biệt.

[Viral Infection]
Trong Singularity Expansion, HP của kẻ địch tăng theo từng vòng, và các hiệu ứng kẻ địch mạnh hơn sẽ được mở khóa khi vòng đấu tiến triển.

[Vigor]
Mỗi lần một Resonators tham gia thử thách, 1 điểm Vigor sẽ bị tiêu hao. Resonators với 0 Vigor không thể được triển khai. Vigor được tính riêng cho Stability Accords và Singularity Expansion.

[Weapon & Echoes Occupation]
Các Resonators khác nhau không thể sử dụng cùng một vũ khí và Echoes trong sự kiện này. Nếu một Resonators trong đội đã trang bị vũ khí hoặc Echoes mà một Resonators khác đã sử dụng trong thử thách trước đó, bạn không thể bắt đầu thử thách với đội này.
